rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a literal visual image or picture.

example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 tou4 pin3 hou2 cing1 co2

rows.note: Use this for an abstract image in the mind or for how a person, group, or company is perceived.

example.english: Their image in the company is very professional.
example.traditional: 佢喺公司入面嘅形象好專業。
